create function private.jd_relation_admission_profile() returns jsonb language sql immutable set search_path='' as $fn$
  select $profile${"schemaVersion":"jd-relation-admission/1.0.0","storedSchemaVersion":"requirements/2.0.0","producerVersion":"jd-relations/1.0.0","semanticCodecVersion":"jd-relation-command/1.0.0","jsonSchemaSha256":"973fc280196206826f9d41703e2e5bb9a192e7fe6f9365c5f73649ea57715d1c","aliasPolicy":{"version":"jd-local-aliases/1.0.0","sha256":"e5298fd95320299996a4f5eceff3fc7afcd61ed636aaec386e1d4107a7500fa2"},"relationPolicy":{"version":"jd-local-relation-rules/1.0.0","sha256":"fd69dde2640bcdc1cdd76ce622015cb577090d61581515585f7cdfe0cdcd8cdc"},"unicodePolicy":{"version":"jd-unicode-profile/1.0.0","sha256":"f3f8335d9a957bc16e33d61321f28ed7a12c8c81ff8912f0c17c041d86d95571"},"budgets":{"sourceUtf16":20000,"clauseUtf16":2000,"requirements":300,"clauses":300,"tokens":1000,"operands":32,"nodes":1024,"rawDepth":8,"durationCandidates":8,"bodyJsonbUtf8Bytes":1048576}}$profile$::jsonb
$fn$;

create function private.jd_relation_canonical_json(p_value jsonb,p_spaced boolean default false,p_depth integer default 0)
returns text language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare kind text collate "C"; result text collate "C"; item jsonb; key text collate "C"; number_value numeric;
  separator text collate "C":=case when p_spaced then ', ' else ',' end;
begin
  if p_value is null or p_depth>32 then raise exception 'Invalid JD semantic value' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  kind:=jsonb_typeof(p_value);
  if kind in ('null','boolean','string') then return p_value::text; end if;
  if kind='number' then
    number_value:=(p_value#>>'{}')::numeric;
    if number_value<>trunc(number_value) or abs(number_value)>9007199254740991 then
      raise exception 'Invalid JD semantic integer' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    return number_value::bigint::text;
  end if;
  result:='';
  if kind='array' then
    for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_value) loop
      if result<>'' then result:=result||separator; end if;
      result:=result||private.jd_relation_canonical_json(item,p_spaced,p_depth+1);
    end loop;
    return '['||result||']';
  elsif kind='object' then
    for key in select value from jsonb_object_keys(p_value) as keys(value) order by value collate "C" loop
      if key collate "C" !~ '^[ -~]+$' then raise exception 'Invalid JD semantic key' using errcode='22023'; end if;
      if result<>'' then result:=result||separator; end if;
      result:=result||to_jsonb(key)::text||case when p_spaced then ': ' else ':' end
        ||private.jd_relation_canonical_json(p_value->key,p_spaced,p_depth+1);
    end loop;
    return '{'||result||'}';
  end if;
  raise exception 'Invalid JD semantic type' using errcode='22023';
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_in_ranges(p_ranges jsonb,p_codepoint integer) returns boolean
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare low_value integer:=0; high_value integer:=jsonb_array_length(p_ranges)-1; middle_value integer; pair jsonb;
begin
  while low_value<=high_value loop
    middle_value:=(low_value+high_value)/2; pair:=p_ranges->middle_value;
    if p_codepoint<(pair->>0)::integer then high_value:=middle_value-1;
    elsif p_codepoint>(pair->>1)::integer then low_value:=middle_value+1;
    else return true; end if;
  end loop;
  return false;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_mapping(p_pairs jsonb,p_codepoint integer) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare low_value integer:=0; high_value integer:=jsonb_array_length(p_pairs)-1; middle_value integer; pair jsonb;
begin
  while low_value<=high_value loop
    middle_value:=(low_value+high_value)/2; pair:=p_pairs->middle_value;
    if p_codepoint<(pair->>0)::integer then high_value:=middle_value-1;
    elsif p_codepoint>(pair->>0)::integer then low_value:=middle_value+1;
    else return pair->1; end if;
  end loop;
  return null;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_lower(p_text text) returns text
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare data jsonb:=private.jd_relation_unicode_profile()->'data'; result text collate "C":=''; scalar text collate "C"; point integer;
  mapped jsonb; target jsonb; position_value integer; cursor_value integer; before_cased boolean; after_cased boolean;
begin
  for position_value in 1..char_length(p_text) loop
    scalar:=substring(p_text from position_value for 1); point:=ascii(scalar);
    if point=931 then
      before_cased:=false; after_cased:=false; cursor_value:=position_value-1;
      while cursor_value>=1 loop
        point:=ascii(substring(p_text from cursor_value for 1));
        if not private.jd_relation_in_ranges(data->'caseIgnorableRanges',point) then
          before_cased:=private.jd_relation_in_ranges(data->'casedRanges',point); exit; end if;
        cursor_value:=cursor_value-1;
      end loop;
      cursor_value:=position_value+1;
      while cursor_value<=char_length(p_text) loop
        point:=ascii(substring(p_text from cursor_value for 1));
        if not private.jd_relation_in_ranges(data->'caseIgnorableRanges',point) then
          after_cased:=private.jd_relation_in_ranges(data->'casedRanges',point); exit; end if;
        cursor_value:=cursor_value+1;
      end loop;
      if before_cased and not after_cased then result:=result||chr(962); continue; end if;
      point:=931;
    end if;
    mapped:=private.jd_relation_mapping(data->'defaultLowerMappings',point);
    if mapped is null then result:=result||scalar;
    else for target in select value from jsonb_array_elements(mapped) loop result:=result||chr((target#>>'{}')::integer); end loop; end if;
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_fold(p_text text) returns text
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare pairs jsonb:=private.jd_relation_unicode_profile()->'data'->'regexAsciiFoldMappings';
  result text collate "C":=''; scalar text collate "C"; mapped jsonb; position_value integer;
begin
  for position_value in 1..char_length(p_text) loop
    scalar:=substring(p_text from position_value for 1); mapped:=private.jd_relation_mapping(pairs,ascii(scalar));
    result:=result||case when mapped is null then scalar else chr((mapped#>>'{}')::integer) end;
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_trim(p_text text) returns text
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare ranges jsonb:=private.jd_relation_unicode_profile()->'data'->'whitespaceRanges'; first_value integer:=1; last_value integer:=char_length(p_text);
begin
  while first_value<=last_value and private.jd_relation_in_ranges(ranges,ascii(substring(p_text from first_value for 1))) loop first_value:=first_value+1; end loop;
  while last_value>=first_value and private.jd_relation_in_ranges(ranges,ascii(substring(p_text from last_value for 1))) loop last_value:=last_value-1; end loop;
  return substring(p_text from first_value for greatest(0,last_value-first_value+1));
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_normalize(p_text text,p_trim boolean default true) returns text
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare ranges jsonb:=private.jd_relation_unicode_profile()->'data'->'whitespaceRanges'; source text collate "C":=private.jd_relation_lower(p_text);
  result text collate "C":=''; scalar text collate "C"; position_value integer; was_space boolean:=false;
begin
  if p_trim then source:=private.jd_relation_trim(source); end if;
  for position_value in 1..char_length(source) loop
    scalar:=substring(source from position_value for 1);
    if private.jd_relation_in_ranges(ranges,ascii(scalar)) then
      if not was_space then result:=result||' '; end if; was_space:=true;
    else result:=result||scalar; was_space:=false; end if;
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_class_contents(p_ranges jsonb) returns text
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare result text collate "C":=''; pair jsonb;
begin
  for pair in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_ranges) loop
    result:=result||chr((pair->>0)::integer)||case when pair->>0=pair->>1 then '' else '-'||chr((pair->>1)::integer) end;
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_pattern(p_pattern text) returns text
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare result text collate "C":=p_pattern; data jsonb:=private.jd_relation_unicode_profile()->'data';
begin
  result:=replace(result,'\p{L}\p{N}\p{M}',private.jd_relation_class_contents(data->'identifierRanges'));
  result:=replace(result,'\p{L}\p{N}',private.jd_relation_class_contents(private.jd_relation_ln_ranges()));
  result:=replace(result,'\s','['||private.jd_relation_class_contents(data->'whitespaceRanges')||']');
  result:=replace(result,'\d','[0-9]');
  -- On the scalar-preserving ASCII /iu fold, JS regex-word is [a-z0-9_].
  result:=replace(result,'\b','(?:(?<![a-z0-9_])(?=[a-z0-9_])|(?<=[a-z0-9_])(?![a-z0-9_]))');
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_matches(p_text text,p_pattern text,p_groups integer default 0,p_limit integer default 1000,p_fold boolean default true,p_first boolean default false)
returns jsonb language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare source text collate "C":=case when p_fold then private.jd_relation_fold(p_text) else p_text end;
  pattern text collate "C":=private.jd_relation_pattern(p_pattern); result jsonb:='[]'; groups_value jsonb;
  cursor_value integer:=1; start_value integer; end_value integer; group_start integer; group_end integer; group_value integer;
begin
  if p_groups not between 0 and 8 or p_limit not between 1 and 1000 then raise exception 'Invalid JD regex work bound' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  loop
    start_value:=regexp_instr(source collate "C",pattern, cursor_value,1,0);
    exit when start_value=0;
    end_value:=regexp_instr(source collate "C",pattern,cursor_value,1,1);
    if end_value<=start_value or jsonb_array_length(result)>=p_limit then raise exception 'JD regex work limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    groups_value:='[]';
    for group_value in 1..p_groups loop
      group_start:=regexp_instr(source collate "C",pattern,cursor_value,1,0,'',group_value);
      group_end:=regexp_instr(source collate "C",pattern,cursor_value,1,1,'',group_value);
      groups_value:=groups_value||jsonb_build_array(case when group_start=0 then 'null'::jsonb else
        jsonb_build_object('start',group_start-1,'end',group_end-1,'quote',substring(p_text from group_start for group_end-group_start)) end);
    end loop;
    result:=result||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('start',start_value-1,'end',end_value-1,
      'quote',substring(p_text from start_value for end_value-start_value),'groups',groups_value));
    exit when p_first;
    cursor_value:=end_value;
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_test(p_text text,p_pattern text,p_fold boolean default true) returns boolean
language sql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
  select (case when p_fold then private.jd_relation_fold(p_text) else p_text end) collate "C" ~ private.jd_relation_pattern(p_pattern)
$$;

create function private.jd_relation_literals(p_text text,p_literal text,p_boundary text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare source text collate "C":=private.jd_relation_fold(p_text); literal_value text collate "C":=private.jd_relation_fold(p_literal);
  ranges jsonb; result jsonb:='[]'; cursor_value integer:=1; found_value integer; end_value integer; point integer; accepted boolean;
begin
  if literal_value='' or p_boundary not in ('ln','alias') then raise exception 'Invalid JD literal policy' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  ranges:=case when p_boundary='ln' then private.jd_relation_ln_ranges() else private.jd_relation_unicode_profile()->'data'->'identifierRanges' end;
  loop
    found_value:=strpos(substring(source from cursor_value) collate "C",literal_value collate "C");
    exit when found_value=0;
    found_value:=found_value+cursor_value-1; end_value:=found_value+char_length(literal_value); accepted:=true;
    if found_value>1 then
      point:=ascii(substring(source from found_value-1 for 1));
      accepted:=not private.jd_relation_in_ranges(ranges,point) and not (p_boundary='alias' and point in (36,95,46));
    end if;
    if accepted and end_value<=char_length(source) then
      point:=ascii(substring(source from end_value for 1));
      accepted:=not private.jd_relation_in_ranges(ranges,point) and not (p_boundary='alias' and point in (36,95));
      if accepted and p_boundary='alias' and point=46 and end_value<char_length(source) then
        point:=ascii(substring(source from end_value+1 for 1));
        accepted:=not private.jd_relation_in_ranges(ranges,point) and point not in (36,95);
      end if;
    end if;
    if accepted then
      if jsonb_array_length(result)>=case when p_boundary='alias' then 300 else 1000 end then raise exception 'JD literal work limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
      result:=result||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('start',found_value-1,'end',end_value-1,'quote',substring(p_text from found_value for end_value-found_value)));
    end if;
    cursor_value:=case when accepted then end_value else found_value+1 end;
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_source_lines(p_source text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb:='[]'; line text collate "C"; labels jsonb; segments jsonb; parts jsonb; separators jsonb;
  segment jsonb; part jsonb; label jsonb; separator jsonb; raw text collate "C"; text_value text collate "C"; metadata_value text collate "C";
  offset_value integer:=0; first_value integer; end_value integer; leading_value integer; index_value integer;
  ranges jsonb:=private.jd_relation_unicode_profile()->'data'->'whitespaceRanges';
begin
  foreach line in array string_to_array(p_source,E'\n') loop
    labels:='[]';
    if private.jd_relation_test(private.jd_relation_trim(line),'^(?:title|role|location|employment\s*type|exp(?:erience)?\s*range)\s*:') then
      labels:=private.jd_relation_matches(line,'(?:title|role|location|employment\s*type|exp(?:erience)?\s*range)\s*:',0,1000);
    end if;
    segments:='[]';
    if jsonb_array_length(labels)>0 then
      for index_value in 0..jsonb_array_length(labels)-1 loop
        label:=labels->index_value;
        metadata_value:=private.jd_relation_lower(private.jd_relation_trim(split_part(label->>'quote',':',1)));
        segments:=segments||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('begin',label->'start','end',
          coalesce((labels->(index_value+1)->>'start')::integer,char_length(line)),'kind',metadata_value));
      end loop;
    else segments:=jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('begin',0,'end',char_length(line),'kind',null)); end if;
    for segment in select value from jsonb_array_elements(segments) loop
      parts:='[]'; first_value:=(segment->>'begin')::integer;
      if segment->'kind'<>'null'::jsonb then parts:=jsonb_build_array(segment);
      else
        raw:=substring(line from first_value+1 for (segment->>'end')::integer-first_value);
        separators:=private.jd_relation_matches(raw,';\s*|(?:,\s*|,?\s+and\s+)(?=(?:\d{1,2}\s*\+?\s*years?|no\b|not\b))|\s+but\s+(?=(?:no|not)\b)',0,1000);
        for separator in select value from jsonb_array_elements(separators) loop
          parts:=parts||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('begin',first_value,'end',(segment->>'begin')::integer+(separator->>'start')::integer,'kind',null));
          first_value:=(segment->>'begin')::integer+(separator->>'end')::integer;
        end loop;
        parts:=parts||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('begin',first_value,'end',segment->'end','kind',null));
      end if;
      for part in select value from jsonb_array_elements(parts) loop
        first_value:=(part->>'begin')::integer; end_value:=(part->>'end')::integer;
        raw:=substring(line from first_value+1 for end_value-first_value); text_value:=private.jd_relation_trim(raw);
        leading_value:=0;
        while leading_value<char_length(raw) and private.jd_relation_in_ranges(ranges,ascii(substring(raw from leading_value+1 for 1))) loop
          leading_value:=leading_value+1;
        end loop;
        if text_value='' then leading_value:=0; end if;
        result:=result||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('text',text_value,'start',offset_value+first_value+leading_value,
          'end',offset_value+first_value+leading_value+char_length(text_value),'metadata',part->'kind'));
      end loop;
    end loop;
    offset_value:=offset_value+char_length(line)+1;
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_heading(p_text text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
begin
  if private.jd_relation_test(p_text,'^(requirements|job requirements|qualifications|required qualifications|basic qualifications|minimum qualifications|required skills(?: and experience)?|skills and experience|must have|essential skills):?$') then
    return jsonb_build_object('heading','required','company',false);
  elsif private.jd_relation_test(p_text,'^(preferred qualifications|preferred|nice to have):?$') then
    return jsonb_build_object('heading','preferred','company',false);
  elsif private.jd_relation_test(p_text,'^((?:key |job )?responsibilities|duties):?$') then
    return jsonb_build_object('heading','contextual','company',false);
  elsif private.jd_relation_test(p_text,'^about (?:the job|this role):?$') then
    return jsonb_build_object('heading','unknown','company',false);
  elsif private.jd_relation_test(p_text,'^(benefits|about (?!the job\b|this role\b)[\p{L}\p{N}][\p{L}\p{N}& .,''’–-]{0,80}|company overview|equal opportunity):?$') then
    return jsonb_build_object('heading','unknown','company',true);
  end if;
  return null;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_importance(p_text text,p_heading text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare required_value boolean; preferred_value boolean; value text collate "C";
begin
  required_value:=private.jd_relation_test(regexp_replace(private.jd_relation_fold(p_text) collate "C",
    private.jd_relation_pattern('\bwhere required\b'),'','g'),'\b(must|required|mandatory|essential|minimum)\b');
  preferred_value:=private.jd_relation_test(p_text,'\b(preferred|desirable|nice[ -]to[ -]have|bonus|optional)\b');
  if required_value and preferred_value then return jsonb_build_object('importance','unknown','importanceBasis','unknown','ambiguity',jsonb_build_array('conflicting_importance')); end if;
  value:=case when required_value then 'required' when preferred_value then 'preferred' else p_heading end;
  return jsonb_build_object('importance',value,'importanceBasis',case when value='unknown' then 'unknown' else 'explicit' end,'ambiguity','[]'::jsonb);
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_alias(p_value text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare literal_value text collate "C":=private.jd_relation_lower(p_value); kind text collate "C":='unmapped'; concept text collate "C"; canonical_value text collate "C";
begin
  if literal_value in ('javascript','js') then
    concept:='local-software:javascript'; canonical_value:='JavaScript'; kind:=case when literal_value='javascript' then 'exact' else 'alias' end;
  elsif literal_value in ('postgresql','postgres') then
    concept:='local-software:postgresql'; canonical_value:='PostgreSQL'; kind:=case when literal_value='postgresql' then 'exact' else 'alias' end;
  end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'policyVersion','jd-local-aliases/1.0.0','conceptId',concept,'canonicalValue',canonical_value,
    'prospectiveCreditGroup',case when concept is null then null else encode(extensions.digest(convert_to('jd-local-aliases/1.0.0:'||concept,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') end);
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_alias_mentions(p_text text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare mentions jsonb:='[]'; literal_value text collate "C"; item jsonb; result jsonb;
begin
  foreach literal_value in array array['JavaScript','PostgreSQL','Postgres','JS'] loop
    for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(private.jd_relation_literals(p_text,literal_value,'alias')) loop
      mentions:=mentions||jsonb_build_array(item||jsonb_build_object('mapping',private.jd_relation_alias(item->>'quote')));
    end loop;
  end loop;
  if jsonb_array_length(mentions)>300 then raise exception 'JD alias mention limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by (value->>'start')::integer,(value->>'end')::integer),'[]'::jsonb) into result from jsonb_array_elements(mentions);
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_requirement(p_source text,p_evidence jsonb,p_type text,p_value text,p_minimum integer,p_maximum integer,
  p_importance jsonb,p_heading_evidence jsonb,p_metadata text,p_negated boolean,p_ordinal integer) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare cue jsonb:='null'; ambiguity jsonb:=p_importance->'ambiguity'; value_importance text collate "C":=p_importance->>'importance';
  basis text collate "C":=p_importance->>'importanceBasis';
begin
  if private.jd_relation_utf16_length(p_evidence->>'quote')>2000 or p_ordinal>=300 then raise exception 'JD observation limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if p_metadata is not null or p_negated or private.jd_relation_importance(p_evidence->>'quote','unknown')->>'importanceBasis'='explicit' then
    cue:=p_evidence-'spanId';
  elsif basis='explicit' then cue:=coalesce(p_heading_evidence,'null'::jsonb); end if;
  if p_negated then value_importance:='contextual'; basis:='explicit'; end if;
  if p_type='experience' and p_maximum is not null then ambiguity:=ambiguity||jsonb_build_array('experience_upper_bound_review'); end if;
  if p_type='skill' and private.jd_relation_test(p_evidence->>'quote','\bor\b') then ambiguity:=ambiguity||jsonb_build_array('skill_alternative_review'); end if;
  if p_negated then ambiguity:=ambiguity||jsonb_build_array('negated_clause_review'); end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('id','00000000-0000-4000-8000-'||lpad((p_ordinal+1)::text,12,'0'),'type',p_type,'value',p_value,
    'importance',value_importance,'importanceBasis',basis,'importanceEvidence',cue,'derivation','exact','minimumYears',p_minimum,
    'negated',p_negated,'ambiguity',ambiguity,'dedupGroup',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_type||':'||private.jd_relation_normalize(p_value,false),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
    'evidence',p_evidence,'confidence',jsonb_build_object('kind','uncalibrated','value',null));
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_expected_body(p_body jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare source text collate "C":=p_body->>'sourceText'; lines jsonb:=private.jd_relation_source_lines(source);
  requirements jsonb:='[]'; decorated jsonb:='[]'; retained jsonb:='[]'; warnings jsonb;
  line jsonb; evidence jsonb; heading_value text collate "C":='unknown'; heading_evidence jsonb:='null'; heading_change jsonb;
  company_context boolean:=false; text_value text collate "C"; metadata_value text collate "C"; importance_value jsonb; negated boolean;
  experience_metadata boolean; range_match jsonb; minimum_value integer; maximum_value integer; types text[] collate "C"; type_value text collate "C";
  skill text collate "C"; matches jsonb; requirement_value jsonb; mapping_value jsonb; tokens jsonb; token jsonb; mention jsonb; mentions jsonb;
  seen_literals text[] collate "C"; literal_value text collate "C"; group_value jsonb; in_clause jsonb; token_count integer:=0; state_value text collate "C";
  supported boolean:=(p_body->>'locale') collate "C"='en-IN' and (p_body->>'domain') collate "C"='software-engineering';
begin
  -- The registered legacy observations are reconstructed first, including metadata.
  for line in select value from jsonb_array_elements(lines) loop
    text_value:=line->>'text'; metadata_value:=line->>'metadata';
    if text_value='' then continue; end if;
    evidence:=private.jd_relation_span(source,(line->>'start')::integer,(line->>'end')::integer);
    heading_change:=private.jd_relation_heading(text_value);
    if heading_change is not null then
      heading_value:=heading_change->>'heading'; company_context:=(heading_change->>'company')::boolean;
      heading_evidence:=case when heading_value='unknown' then 'null'::jsonb else evidence-'spanId' end;
      continue;
    end if;
    if company_context or (metadata_value is not null and metadata_value in ('title','role','employment type')) then continue; end if;
    range_match:=private.jd_relation_matches(text_value,'\b(\d{1,2})(?:\s*[-–]\s*(\d{1,2})|\s*\+)?\s*(?:years?|yrs?)\b',2,1,true,true)->0;
    minimum_value:=case when range_match is null then null else (range_match->'groups'->0->>'quote')::integer end;
    maximum_value:=case when range_match->'groups'->1='null'::jsonb then null else (range_match->'groups'->1->>'quote')::integer end;
    experience_metadata:=metadata_value is not null and private.jd_relation_test(metadata_value,'^exp(?:erience)?\s*range$');
    importance_value:=case
      when experience_metadata and range_match is not null then jsonb_build_object('importance','required','importanceBasis','explicit','ambiguity','[]'::jsonb)
      when metadata_value='location' then jsonb_build_object('importance','contextual','importanceBasis','explicit','ambiguity','[]'::jsonb)
      else private.jd_relation_importance(text_value,heading_value) end;
    negated:=private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(no|not(?!\s+only\b)|without|never)\b');
    types:='{}';
    if range_match is not null and (experience_metadata or private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(experience|working|professional)\b')) then types:=array_append(types,'experience'); end if;
    if private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(bachelor|master|degree|b\.tech|btech|bsc|msc|phd|diploma)\b')
      or private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'(?<![\p{L}\p{N}])B\.?E\.?(?![\p{L}\p{N}])',false) then types:=array_append(types,'education'); end if;
    if private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(certification|certified|certificate)\b') then types:=array_append(types,'certification'); end if;
    if private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(based in|located in|location|relocate|on[ -]site|hybrid|remote|bengaluru|bangalore|mumbai|delhi|hyderabad|pune)\b') then types:=array_append(types,'location'); end if;
    if private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(work authorization|authori[sz]ed to work|visa|sponsorship|right to work|work permit)\b') then types:=array_append(types,'authorization'); end if;
    foreach type_value in array types loop
      requirements:=requirements||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_requirement(source,evidence,type_value,text_value,
        case when type_value='experience' then minimum_value else null end,maximum_value,importance_value,heading_evidence,metadata_value,negated,jsonb_array_length(requirements)));
    end loop;
    if metadata_value is null then
      foreach skill in array array['TypeScript','JavaScript','Python','Java','SQL','React','Node.js','PostgreSQL','Docker','Kubernetes','Git','AWS','Azure','C++','C#',
        'FastAPI','Flask','Pydantic','LLMs','LLM','RAG','Generative AI','Retrieval-Augmented Generation','embedding models','embeddings','vector databases',
        'AI agents','AI agent','agent orchestration','NoSQL','Redis','async/await','asynchronous programming','GCP','Google Cloud','Object-Oriented Programming','OOP','REST APIs','microservices'] loop
        matches:=private.jd_relation_literals(text_value,skill,'ln');
        if jsonb_array_length(matches)>0 then requirements:=requirements||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_requirement(source,evidence,'skill',matches->0->>'quote',null,null,
          importance_value,heading_evidence,null,negated,jsonb_array_length(requirements))); end if;
      end loop;
    end if;
    if heading_value='contextual' and private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(build|develop|design|maintain|implement|test|collaborate|lead|deliver)\b') then
      requirements:=requirements||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_requirement(source,evidence,'responsibility',text_value,null,null,
        importance_value,heading_evidence,metadata_value,negated,jsonb_array_length(requirements)));
    end if;
  end loop;
  -- A07 decorates literal observations without replacing their quoted value.
  for requirement_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(requirements) loop
    tokens:='[]'; mapping_value:='null'; evidence:=requirement_value->'evidence';
    if requirement_value->>'type'='skill' then
      mapping_value:=private.jd_relation_alias(requirement_value->>'value');
      if mapping_value->>'kind'='exact' then
        mentions:=private.jd_relation_alias_mentions(evidence->>'quote');
        for mention in select value from jsonb_array_elements(mentions) loop
          if private.jd_relation_lower(mention->>'quote')=private.jd_relation_lower(requirement_value->>'value') then
            tokens:=tokens||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_span(source,(evidence->>'start')::integer+(mention->>'start')::integer,
              (evidence->>'start')::integer+(mention->>'end')::integer));
          end if;
        end loop;
        if jsonb_array_length(tokens)=0 then mapping_value:=private.jd_relation_alias(''); end if;
      else
        for token in select value from jsonb_array_elements(private.jd_relation_literals(evidence->>'quote',requirement_value->>'value','ln')) loop
          tokens:=tokens||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_span(source,(evidence->>'start')::integer+(token->>'start')::integer,
            (evidence->>'start')::integer+(token->>'end')::integer));
        end loop;
      end if;
    end if;
    token_count:=token_count+jsonb_array_length(tokens);
    if token_count>1000 then raise exception 'JD alias token limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    decorated:=decorated||jsonb_build_array(requirement_value||jsonb_build_object('mapping',mapping_value,'tokenEvidence',tokens));
  end loop;
  requirements:=decorated; heading_value:='unknown'; heading_evidence:='null'; company_context:=false;
  -- The separate alias pass retains unknown clauses and their complete member list.
  for line in select value from jsonb_array_elements(lines) loop
    text_value:=line->>'text'; metadata_value:=line->>'metadata';
    if text_value='' then continue; end if;
    evidence:=private.jd_relation_span(source,(line->>'start')::integer,(line->>'end')::integer);
    heading_change:=private.jd_relation_heading(text_value);
    if heading_change is not null then
      heading_value:=heading_change->>'heading'; company_context:=(heading_change->>'company')::boolean;
      heading_evidence:=case when heading_value='unknown' then 'null'::jsonb else evidence-'spanId' end; continue;
    end if;
    if company_context or metadata_value is not null then continue; end if;
    importance_value:=private.jd_relation_importance(text_value,heading_value);
    negated:=private.jd_relation_test(text_value,'\b(no|not(?!\s+only\b)|without|never)\b');
    mentions:=private.jd_relation_alias_mentions(text_value); seen_literals:='{}';
    for mention in select value from jsonb_array_elements(mentions) where value->'mapping'->>'kind'='alias' loop
      literal_value:=private.jd_relation_lower(mention->>'quote');
      if literal_value=any(seen_literals) then continue; end if; seen_literals:=array_append(seen_literals,literal_value);
      tokens:='[]';
      for group_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(mentions)
        where value->'mapping'->>'kind'='alias' and private.jd_relation_lower(value->>'quote')=literal_value loop
        tokens:=tokens||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_span(source,(evidence->>'start')::integer+(group_value->>'start')::integer,
          (evidence->>'start')::integer+(group_value->>'end')::integer));
      end loop;
      token_count:=token_count+jsonb_array_length(tokens);
      if token_count>1000 then raise exception 'JD alias token limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
      requirements:=requirements||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_requirement(source,evidence,'skill',mention->>'quote',null,null,
        importance_value,heading_evidence,null,negated,jsonb_array_length(requirements))||jsonb_build_object('mapping',mention->'mapping','tokenEvidence',tokens));
    end loop;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value->'id' order by ordinality),'[]'::jsonb) into in_clause
      from jsonb_array_elements(requirements) with ordinality where value->'evidence'->'start'=evidence->'start' and value->'evidence'->'end'=evidence->'end';
    if jsonb_array_length(in_clause)>0 or importance_value->>'importance' in ('required','preferred')
      or jsonb_array_length(importance_value->'ambiguity')>0 or negated then
      if private.jd_relation_utf16_length(text_value)>2000 or jsonb_array_length(retained)>=300 then raise exception 'JD retained clause limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
      retained:=retained||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('evidence',evidence,'importance',case when negated then 'contextual' else importance_value->>'importance' end,
        'negated',negated,'interpretation',case when jsonb_array_length(in_clause)>0 then 'partial_vocabulary' else 'unmapped' end,
        'reviewRequired',true,'requirementIds',in_clause));
    end if;
  end loop;
  state_value:=case when not supported then 'unsupported' when jsonb_array_length(requirements)>0 or jsonb_array_length(retained)>0 then 'review_required' else 'insufficient' end;
  warnings:=case when not supported then jsonb_build_array('unsupported_domain_or_locale') else '[]'::jsonb end
    ||jsonb_build_array('uncalibrated_requirements','domain_pack_review_pending','local_alias_policy_not_admitted','clause_interpretation_review_pending');
  return p_body||jsonb_build_object('id','ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff','state',state_value,'requirements',requirements,'retainedClauses',retained,
    'relations',jsonb_build_object('clauses',private.jd_relation_relations(source,requirements,retained,supported)),'warnings',warnings);
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_duration(p_source text,p_evidence jsonb,p_supported boolean,p_negated boolean) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare matches jsonb; item jsonb; candidates jsonb:='[]'; operators jsonb:='[]'; groups_value jsonb; match_value jsonb;
  result jsonb; reason_value text collate "C"; amount integer; upper_value integer; comparator text collate "C"; prefix text collate "C"; group_index integer;
  start_value integer:=(p_evidence->>'start')::integer; lower_bound jsonb; upper_bound jsonb; kind text collate "C";
begin
  matches:=private.jd_relation_matches(p_evidence->>'quote',
    '(?<![\p{L}\p{N}\p{M}_.,])(?:(at\s+least|more\s+than|over|at\s+most|less\s+than|under|exactly)\s+)?(\d{1,3})(?:\s*([-–])\s*(\d{1,3})|(\s*\+))?\s*(years?|yrs?)(?![\p{L}\p{N}\p{M}_])',6,8);
  for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(matches) loop
    candidates:=candidates||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_span(p_source,start_value+(item->>'start')::integer,start_value+(item->>'end')::integer));
  end loop;
  result:=jsonb_build_object('kind','unknown','evidence',p_evidence,'lower',null,'upper',null,'operatorEvidence','[]'::jsonb,
    'candidateEvidence',candidates,'reason',null,'subjectBinding','literal_clause_only','evaluated',false);
  if jsonb_array_length(matches)=0 then
    if private.jd_relation_test(p_evidence->>'quote','\b(years?|yrs?|months?|mos?)\b') then reason_value:='unsupported_duration_review';
    else return result||jsonb_build_object('kind','not_stated','evidence',null); end if;
  elsif not p_supported then reason_value:='unsupported_segment_review';
  elsif p_negated then reason_value:='negated_duration_review';
  elsif jsonb_array_length(matches)>1 then reason_value:='multiple_durations_review';
  else
    match_value:=matches->0; groups_value:=match_value->'groups';
    amount:=(groups_value->1->>'quote')::integer;
    upper_value:=case when groups_value->3='null'::jsonb then null else (groups_value->3->>'quote')::integer end;
    comparator:=case when groups_value->0='null'::jsonb then '' else private.jd_relation_normalize(groups_value->0->>'quote') end;
    prefix:=private.jd_relation_normalize(substring(p_evidence->>'quote' from 1 for (match_value->>'start')::integer));
    if prefix not in ('','must have','requires','required:') and not private.jd_relation_test(prefix,'^(?:exp(?:erience)?\s*range|experience)\s*:$') then reason_value:='duration_prefix_review';
    elsif amount>100 or upper_value>100 then reason_value:='duration_value_review';
    elsif comparator<>'' and (groups_value->2<>'null'::jsonb or groups_value->4<>'null'::jsonb) then reason_value:='mixed_comparator_review';
    elsif upper_value is not null and amount>upper_value then reason_value:='inverted_range_review';
    else
      foreach group_index in array array[0,2,4] loop
        item:=groups_value->group_index;
        if item<>'null'::jsonb then operators:=operators||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_span(p_source,
          start_value+(item->>'start')::integer,start_value+(item->>'end')::integer)); end if;
      end loop;
      lower_bound:=jsonb_build_object('value',amount,'inclusive',true,'evidence',private.jd_relation_span(p_source,
        start_value+(groups_value->1->>'start')::integer,start_value+(groups_value->1->>'end')::integer));
      upper_bound:='null';
      if upper_value is not null then
        kind:='range'; upper_bound:=jsonb_build_object('value',upper_value,'inclusive',true,'evidence',private.jd_relation_span(p_source,
          start_value+(groups_value->3->>'start')::integer,start_value+(groups_value->3->>'end')::integer));
      elsif comparator='at least' or groups_value->4<>'null'::jsonb then kind:='at_least';
      elsif comparator in ('more than','over') then kind:='more_than'; lower_bound:=lower_bound||jsonb_build_object('inclusive',false);
      elsif comparator='at most' then kind:='at_most'; upper_bound:=lower_bound; lower_bound:='null';
      elsif comparator in ('less than','under') then kind:='less_than'; upper_bound:=lower_bound||jsonb_build_object('inclusive',false); lower_bound:='null';
      elsif comparator='exactly' then kind:='exactly'; upper_bound:=lower_bound;
      else reason_value:='comparator_unstated_review'; end if;
      if reason_value is null then return result||jsonb_build_object('kind',kind,'evidence',candidates->0,'lower',lower_bound,'upper',upper_bound,'operatorEvidence',operators); end if;
    end if;
  end if;
  return result||jsonb_build_object('reason',reason_value);
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_relations(p_source text,p_requirements jsonb,p_retained jsonb,p_supported boolean) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
declare inputs jsonb:=p_retained; result jsonb:='[]'; clause_value jsonb; evidence jsonb; members jsonb; ids jsonb;
  requirement_value jsonb; token jsonb; observed jsonb; found_index integer; item jsonb; index_value integer;
  depth_value integer; deepest integer; unbalanced boolean; scalar text collate "C"; duration_value jsonb; node_count integer:=0;
  reason_value text collate "C"; expression_value jsonb; operators jsonb; operands jsonb; credit_groups jsonb; credit text collate "C";
  first_evidence jsonb; last_evidence jsonb; left_evidence jsonb; right_evidence jsonb; connector jsonb;
  between_value text collate "C"; prefix text collate "C"; suffix text collate "C"; kinds text[] collate "C"; bad_connector boolean; overlapping boolean;
begin
  for requirement_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_requirements) where value->>'type'='experience' loop
    evidence:=requirement_value->'evidence';
    if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(inputs) where value->'evidence'->'start'=evidence->'start' and value->'evidence'->'end'=evidence->'end') then continue; end if;
    if jsonb_array_length(inputs)>=300 then raise exception 'JD relation clause limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value->'id' order by ordinality),'[]'::jsonb) into ids from jsonb_array_elements(p_requirements) with ordinality
      where value->'evidence'->'start'=evidence->'start' and value->'evidence'->'end'=evidence->'end';
    inputs:=inputs||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('evidence',evidence,'importance',requirement_value->'importance','negated',requirement_value->'negated','requirementIds',ids));
  end loop;
  for clause_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(inputs) order by (value->'evidence'->>'start')::integer,(value->'evidence'->>'end')::integer loop
    evidence:=clause_value->'evidence';
    if private.jd_relation_utf16_length(evidence->>'quote')>2000 then raise exception 'JD relation clause text limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by ordinality),'[]'::jsonb),coalesce(jsonb_agg(value->'id' order by ordinality),'[]'::jsonb) into members,ids
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_requirements) with ordinality where value->'evidence'->'start'=evidence->'start' and value->'evidence'->'end'=evidence->'end';
    observed:='[]';
    for requirement_value in select value from jsonb_array_elements(members) loop
      for token in select value from jsonb_array_elements(requirement_value->'tokenEvidence') loop
        if requirement_value->>'type'<>'skill' or (token->>'start')::integer<(evidence->>'start')::integer
          or (token->>'end')::integer>(evidence->>'end')::integer
          or private.jd_relation_lower(token->>'quote')<>private.jd_relation_lower(requirement_value->>'value') then
          raise exception 'JD relation token identity mismatch' using errcode='22023'; end if;
        select ordinality::integer-1 into found_index from jsonb_array_elements(observed) with ordinality
          where value->'evidence'->'start'=token->'start' and value->'evidence'->'end'=token->'end';
        if found then
          item:=observed->found_index;
          observed:=jsonb_set(observed,array[found_index::text],item||jsonb_build_object('requirementIds',(item->'requirementIds')||jsonb_build_array(requirement_value->'id')));
        else
          if jsonb_array_length(observed)>=32 then raise exception 'JD relation operand limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
          observed:=observed||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('evidence',token,'requirementIds',jsonb_build_array(requirement_value->'id')));
        end if;
      end loop;
    end loop;
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by (value->'evidence'->>'start')::integer,(value->'evidence'->>'end')::integer),'[]'::jsonb) into observed from jsonb_array_elements(observed);
    depth_value:=0; deepest:=0; unbalanced:=false;
    for index_value in 1..char_length(evidence->>'quote') loop
      scalar:=substring(evidence->>'quote' from index_value for 1);
      if scalar='(' then depth_value:=depth_value+1; deepest:=greatest(deepest,depth_value);
        if depth_value>8 then raise exception 'JD raw expression depth limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
      elsif scalar=')' then if depth_value=0 then unbalanced:=true; else depth_value:=depth_value-1; end if; end if;
    end loop;
    unbalanced:=unbalanced or depth_value<>0;
    duration_value:=private.jd_relation_duration(p_source,evidence,p_supported,(clause_value->>'negated')::boolean);
    node_count:=node_count+1+jsonb_array_length(observed)+4*jsonb_array_length(duration_value->'candidateEvidence');
    if node_count>1024 then raise exception 'JD relation node limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    reason_value:=case
      when not p_supported then 'unsupported_segment_review'
      when unbalanced then 'unbalanced_parentheses_review'
      when deepest>0 then 'parenthesized_expression_review'
      when (clause_value->>'negated')::boolean then 'negated_expression_review'
      when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(members) where (value->'ambiguity') ? 'conflicting_importance') then 'conflicting_importance_review'
      when jsonb_array_length(observed)=0 then 'no_discovered_operands_review' else null end;
    operators:='[]'; operands:='[]'; credit_groups:='[]'; kinds:='{}'; bad_connector:=false; overlapping:=false;
    if reason_value is null then
      first_evidence:=observed->0->'evidence'; last_evidence:=observed->(jsonb_array_length(observed)-1)->'evidence';
      prefix:=private.jd_relation_normalize(substring(p_source from (evidence->>'start')::integer+1 for (first_evidence->>'start')::integer-(evidence->>'start')::integer));
      suffix:=private.jd_relation_normalize(substring(p_source from (last_evidence->>'end')::integer+1 for (evidence->>'end')::integer-(last_evidence->>'end')::integer));
      if right(suffix,1) in ('.','!') then suffix:=left(suffix,char_length(suffix)-1); end if;
      for index_value in 1..jsonb_array_length(observed)-1 loop
        left_evidence:=observed->(index_value-1)->'evidence'; right_evidence:=observed->index_value->'evidence';
        if (left_evidence->>'end')::integer>(right_evidence->>'start')::integer then overlapping:=true; exit; end if;
        between_value:=substring(p_source from (left_evidence->>'end')::integer+1 for (right_evidence->>'start')::integer-(left_evidence->>'end')::integer);
        connector:=private.jd_relation_matches(between_value,'^\s*(and|or)\s*$',1,1,true,true)->0;
        if connector is null then bad_connector:=true; exit; end if;
        token:=connector->'groups'->0;
        operators:=operators||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_span(p_source,(left_evidence->>'end')::integer+(token->>'start')::integer,
          (left_evidence->>'end')::integer+(token->>'end')::integer));
        kinds:=array_append(kinds,private.jd_relation_lower(token->>'quote'));
      end loop;
      reason_value:=case
        when overlapping then 'overlapping_operands_review'
        when 'and'=any(kinds) and 'or'=any(kinds) then 'mixed_connectors_review'
        when bad_connector then 'unsupported_connector_review'
        when prefix not in ('','must have','experience with','experience in','hands-on experience with','proficiency in','knowledge of','either','both')
          or suffix not in ('','required','preferred','mandatory','essential','optional','experience','skills','experience required','skills required','is required','are required','is preferred','are preferred') then 'unsupported_scope_review'
        when (prefix='either' and 'and'=any(kinds)) or (prefix='both' and 'or'=any(kinds)) then 'scope_connector_conflict_review' else null end;
    end if;
    for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(observed) loop
      token:=item->'evidence';
      if reason_value is null then operands:=operands||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('kind','atom','value',token->'quote','evidence',token,
        'requirementIds',item->'requirementIds','mapping',private.jd_relation_alias(token->>'quote'))); end if;
      credit:=private.jd_relation_alias(token->>'quote')->>'prospectiveCreditGroup';
      if credit is not null and not credit_groups @> jsonb_build_array(credit) then credit_groups:=credit_groups||jsonb_build_array(credit); end if;
    end loop;
    if reason_value is not null then expression_value:=jsonb_build_object('kind','unknown','reason',reason_value,'evidence',evidence,'observedRequirementIds',ids);
    elsif jsonb_array_length(operands)=1 then expression_value:=operands->0;
    else expression_value:=jsonb_build_object('kind',case when 'or'=any(kinds) then 'any_of' else 'all_of' end,
      'evidence',private.jd_relation_span(p_source,(first_evidence->>'start')::integer,(last_evidence->>'end')::integer),'operands',operands,'operatorEvidence',operators); end if;
    result:=result||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('id',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(
      'fd69dde2640bcdc1cdd76ce622015cb577090d61581515585f7cdfe0cdcd8cdc:ffffffff-ffff-4fff-8fff-ffffffffffff:'
        ||encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_source,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')||':'||(evidence->>'start')||':'||(evidence->>'end'),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
      'evidence',evidence,'reviewRequired',true,'scope',jsonb_build_object('importance',clause_value->'importance','negated',clause_value->'negated'),
      'skillExpression',expression_value,'duration',duration_value,'prospectiveCreditGroups',credit_groups,'numericCredit',null));
  end loop;
  return result;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_lengthless_schema(p_schema jsonb,p_depth integer default 0) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb; member record; item jsonb;
begin
  if p_depth>64 then raise exception 'JD structural schema depth limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_schema)='object' then
    result:='{}';
    for member in select key,value from jsonb_each(p_schema) where key not in ('minLength','maxLength') loop
      result:=result||jsonb_build_object(member.key,private.jd_relation_lengthless_schema(member.value,p_depth+1));
    end loop;
    return result;
  elsif jsonb_typeof(p_schema)='array' then
    result:='[]';
    for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_schema) loop
      result:=result||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_lengthless_schema(item,p_depth+1));
    end loop;
    return result;
  end if;
  return p_schema;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_lengths_valid(p_value jsonb,p_schema jsonb,p_depth integer default 0) returns boolean
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare member record; item jsonb; branch jsonb; branch_count integer; length_value integer;
begin
  if p_value is null or p_schema is null or p_depth>32 then return false; end if;
  if p_schema ? 'anyOf' or p_schema ? 'oneOf' then
    branch_count:=0;
    for branch in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_schema->'anyOf',p_schema->'oneOf')) loop
      if extensions.jsonb_matches_schema(private.jd_relation_lengthless_schema(branch)::json,p_value)
        and private.jd_relation_lengths_valid(p_value,branch,p_depth+1) then branch_count:=branch_count+1; end if;
    end loop;
    if p_schema ? 'oneOf' then return branch_count=1; end if;
    return branch_count>0;
  end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_value)='string' then
    length_value:=private.jd_relation_utf16_length(p_value#>>'{}');
    return (not p_schema ? 'minLength' or length_value>=(p_schema->>'minLength')::integer)
      and (not p_schema ? 'maxLength' or length_value<=(p_schema->>'maxLength')::integer);
  elsif jsonb_typeof(p_value)='array' and p_schema ? 'items' then
    for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_value) loop
      if not private.jd_relation_lengths_valid(item,p_schema->'items',p_depth+1) then return false; end if;
    end loop;
  elsif jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' and p_schema ? 'properties' then
    for member in select key,value from jsonb_each(p_value) loop
      if not private.jd_relation_lengths_valid(member.value,p_schema->'properties'->member.key,p_depth+1) then return false; end if;
    end loop;
  end if;
  return true;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_utf16_length(p_text text) returns integer
language sql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
  select coalesce(sum(case when ascii(substring(p_text from position for 1))>65535 then 2 else 1 end),0)::integer
    from generate_series(1,char_length(p_text)) as positions(position)
$$;

create function private.jd_relation_span(p_source text,p_start integer,p_end integer) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable strict set search_path='' as $$
begin
  if p_start<0 or p_end<=p_start or p_end>char_length(p_source) then
    raise exception 'Invalid JD source span' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  return jsonb_build_object('spanId','jd-'||p_start::text||'-'||p_end::text,
    'start',p_start,'end',p_end,'quote',substring(p_source from p_start+1 for p_end-p_start));
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_clean(p_value jsonb,p_source text,p_requirements jsonb,p_key text default null,p_depth integer default 0)
returns jsonb language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare result jsonb; item jsonb; member record; reference text collate "C"; ordinal_value integer; prior_refs text[] collate "C":='{}';
  start_value integer; end_value integer;
begin
  if p_value is null or p_depth>32 then raise exception 'Invalid JD semantic projection' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if jsonb_typeof(p_value)='array' then
    result:='[]'::jsonb;
    if p_key in ('requirementIds','observedRequirementIds') then
      for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_value) loop
        reference:=item#>>'{}';
        if jsonb_typeof(item)<>'string' or reference=any(prior_refs) then
          raise exception 'Invalid JD semantic reference' using errcode='22023'; end if;
        prior_refs:=array_append(prior_refs,reference);
        select ordinality::integer-1 into ordinal_value from jsonb_array_elements(p_requirements) with ordinality
          where value->>'id'=reference;
        if not found then raise exception 'Dangling JD semantic reference' using errcode='22023'; end if;
        result:=result||to_jsonb(ordinal_value);
      end loop;
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb('/requirements/'||(value#>>'{}')) order by (value#>>'{}')::integer),'[]'::jsonb)
        into result from jsonb_array_elements(result);
      return result;
    elsif p_key='prospectiveCreditGroups' then
      if (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(p_value))<>(select count(distinct value collate "C") from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_value)) then
        raise exception 'Duplicate JD credit reference' using errcode='22023'; end if;
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(value) order by value collate "C"),'[]'::jsonb) into result from jsonb_array_elements_text(p_value);
      return result;
    elsif p_key in ('tokenEvidence','candidateEvidence') then
      for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_value) order by (value->>'start')::integer,(value->>'end')::integer loop
        result:=result||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_clean(item,p_source,p_requirements,null,p_depth+1));
      end loop;
      return result;
    end if;
    for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_value) loop
      result:=result||jsonb_build_array(private.jd_relation_clean(item,p_source,p_requirements,null,p_depth+1));
    end loop;
    return result;
  elsif jsonb_typeof(p_value)='object' then
    if p_value ?& array['start','end','quote'] then
      if not private.evidence_integer(p_value->'start',0,20000) or not private.evidence_integer(p_value->'end',1,20000)
        or jsonb_typeof(p_value->'quote')<>'string' then raise exception 'Invalid JD source span' using errcode='22023'; end if;
      start_value:=(p_value->>'start')::integer; end_value:=(p_value->>'end')::integer;
      if end_value<=start_value or end_value>char_length(p_source)
        or substring(p_source from start_value+1 for end_value-start_value) collate "C" <> (p_value->>'quote') collate "C"
        or private.jd_relation_utf16_length(p_value->>'quote')>2000
        or (p_value ? 'spanId' and p_value->>'spanId' is distinct from 'jd-'||start_value::text||'-'||end_value::text) then
        raise exception 'JD source span mismatch' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    end if;
    result:='{}'::jsonb;
    for member in select key,value from jsonb_each(p_value) where key<>'spanId' loop
      result:=result||jsonb_build_object(member.key,private.jd_relation_clean(member.value,p_source,p_requirements,member.key,p_depth+1));
    end loop;
    return result;
  end if;
  return p_value;
end; $$;

create function private.jd_relation_project(p_body jsonb) returns jsonb
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare requirements jsonb; retained jsonb; clauses jsonb; ids text[] collate "C":='{}'; observations text[] collate "C":='{}';
  clause_ids text[] collate "C":='{}'; clause_spans text[] collate "C":='{}'; item jsonb; observation text collate "C"; key text collate "C"; token_count integer:=0;
begin
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by (value->'evidence'->>'start')::integer,(value->'evidence'->>'end')::integer,
    (value->>'type') collate "C",(value->>'value') collate "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
    into requirements from jsonb_array_elements(p_body->'requirements');
  for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(requirements) loop
    observation:=private.jd_relation_canonical_json(jsonb_build_array(item->'type',item->'evidence'->'start',item->'evidence'->'end',item->'value'));
    if item->>'id'=p_body->>'id' or item->>'id'=any(ids) or observation=any(observations) then
      raise exception 'Duplicate JD observation identity' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    ids:=array_append(ids,item->>'id'); observations:=array_append(observations,observation);
    token_count:=token_count+jsonb_array_length(item->'tokenEvidence');
    if token_count>1000 then raise exception 'JD token work limit' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  end loop;
  for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(p_body->'relations'->'clauses') loop
    key:=item->'evidence'->>'start'||':'||(item->'evidence'->>'end');
    if item->>'id'=any(clause_ids) or key=any(clause_spans) then raise exception 'Duplicate JD relation identity' using errcode='22023'; end if;
    clause_ids:=array_append(clause_ids,item->>'id'); clause_spans:=array_append(clause_spans,key);
  end loop;
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value order by (value->'evidence'->>'start')::integer,(value->'evidence'->>'end')::integer),'[]'::jsonb)
    into retained from jsonb_array_elements(p_body->'retainedClauses');
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value-'id' order by (value->'evidence'->>'start')::integer,(value->'evidence'->>'end')::integer),'[]'::jsonb)
    into clauses from jsonb_array_elements(p_body->'relations'->'clauses');
  return private.jd_relation_clean((p_body-array['id','createdAt','parentVersionId'])||jsonb_build_object(
    'requirements',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(value-'id'),'[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(requirements)),
    'retainedClauses',retained,'relations',jsonb_build_object('clauses',clauses)),p_body->>'sourceText',requirements);
end; $$;

create function private.job_requirement_relations_valid(p_body jsonb) returns boolean
language plpgsql immutable set search_path='' as $$
declare schema_value jsonb:=private.jd_relation_json_schema(); expected jsonb; created_value timestamptz;
begin
  if p_body is null or jsonb_typeof(p_body)<>'object' or getdatabaseencoding()<>'UTF8'
    or octet_length(p_body::text)>1048576 then return false; end if;
  if not extensions.jsonb_matches_schema(private.jd_relation_lengthless_schema(schema_value)::json,p_body)
    or not private.jd_relation_lengths_valid(p_body,schema_value) then return false; end if;
  if p_body->>'parentVersionId'=p_body->>'id'
    or p_body->>'inputSha256' is distinct from encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p_body->>'sourceText','UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') then return false; end if;
  created_value:=(p_body->>'createdAt')::timestamptz;
  if not isfinite(created_value) then return false; end if;
  expected:=private.jd_relation_expected_body(p_body);
  return private.jd_relation_canonical_json(private.jd_relation_project(p_body))
    =private.jd_relation_canonical_json(private.jd_relation_project(expected));
exception when data_exception then return false;
end; $$;

create function private.job_requirement_stored_shape_valid(p_body jsonb) returns boolean
language sql immutable set search_path='' as $$
  select case p_body->>'schemaVersion'
    when 'requirements/1.0.0' then private.job_requirement_shape_valid(p_body)
    when 'requirements/2.0.0' then private.job_requirement_relations_valid(p_body)
    else false end
$$;

-- Add and validate the replacement before removing the old v1-only CHECK.
-- Both changes are inside this forward migration transaction.
alter table public.job_requirement_versions add constraint job_requirement_versions_stored_content_check
  check(octet_length(content::text)<=1048576 and private.job_requirement_stored_shape_valid(content)) not valid;
alter table public.job_requirement_versions validate constraint job_requirement_versions_stored_content_check;
alter table public.job_requirement_versions drop constraint job_requirement_versions_content_check;

create function private.reject_legacy_job_requirement_downgrade() returns trigger
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
begin
  if new.content->>'schemaVersion'='requirements/1.0.0' and new.parent_version_id is not null
    and exists(select 1 from public.job_requirement_versions parent where parent.id=new.parent_version_id
      and parent.content->>'schemaVersion'='requirements/2.0.0') then
    raise exception 'Review the recorded typed JD before saving' using errcode='22023';
  end if;
  return new;
end; $$;
create trigger job_requirement_no_legacy_downgrade before insert on public.job_requirement_versions
  for each row execute function private.reject_legacy_job_requirement_downgrade();

create function public.save_job_requirement_relations(p_user_id uuid,p_analysis_id uuid,p_body jsonb,
  p_expected_version uuid,p_idempotency_key uuid,p_request_id text) returns jsonb
language plpgsql security definer set search_path='' as $$
declare a public.analyses%rowtype; job public.jobs%rowtype; head public.job_requirement_versions%rowtype;
  prior public.job_requirement_versions%rowtype; semantic_value text collate "C"; command jsonb; revision_value integer;
begin
  if p_body is null or p_idempotency_key is null or p_request_id is null or char_length(p_request_id) not between 1 and 100
    or not private.job_requirement_relations_valid(p_body)
    or p_body->'parentVersionId' is distinct from coalesce(to_jsonb(p_expected_version),'null'::jsonb) then
    raise exception 'Invalid JD relation envelope' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  if p_user_id is null or p_analysis_id is null then return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
  -- The same R19/C02 owner mutex precedes every candidate row lock.
  perform private.lock_candidate_owners(array[p_user_id]);
  if not private.try_candidate_privacy_write(p_user_id) then return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
  select * into a from public.analyses where id=p_analysis_id and owner_id=p_user_id for update;
  if not found or a.job_id is null
    or not exists(select 1 from public.memberships where user_id=p_user_id and organization_id=a.organization_id) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
  perform 1 from public.resume_versions v join public.resumes r on r.id=v.resume_id
    where v.id=a.resume_version_id and v.owner_id=p_user_id and v.organization_id=a.organization_id
      and r.owner_id=p_user_id and r.organization_id=a.organization_id and r.status='active' for share of v,r;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
  select * into job from public.jobs where id=a.job_id and owner_id=p_user_id and organization_id=a.organization_id for share;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','not_found'); end if;
  if (p_body->>'ownerId') collate "C" is distinct from p_user_id::text collate "C" or (p_body->>'organizationId') collate "C" is distinct from a.organization_id::text collate "C"
    or (p_body->>'analysisId') collate "C" is distinct from a.id::text collate "C" or (p_body->>'jobId') collate "C" is distinct from job.id::text collate "C" then
    raise exception 'JD relation scope mismatch' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  semantic_value:=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(private.jd_relation_canonical_json(private.jd_relation_project(p_body)),'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
  command:=jsonb_build_object('operation','save_job_requirement_relations','producerVersion','jd-relations/1.0.0',
    'semanticCodecVersion','jd-relation-command/1.0.0','admissionProfileSha256','e82d68b1e58cf220d3584a8d510128d4428441a2b02815711e7f198adaeaacb8',
    'semanticSha256',semantic_value,'expectedVersionId',p_expected_version);
  select * into prior from public.job_requirement_versions where analysis_id=a.id and idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key;
  if found then
    if prior.owner_id<>p_user_id or prior.organization_id<>a.organization_id or prior.job_id<>job.id or prior.command is distinct from command then
      return jsonb_build_object('status','conflict'); end if;
    return jsonb_build_object('status','applied','versionId',prior.id,'revision',prior.revision,'idempotent',true);
  end if;
  select * into head from public.job_requirement_versions where analysis_id=a.id order by revision desc limit 1;
  if head.id is distinct from p_expected_version then return jsonb_build_object('status','conflict'); end if;
  if p_body->>'sourceText' collate "C" is distinct from job.description collate "C"
    or p_body->>'inputSha256' is distinct from encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(job.description,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') then
    raise exception 'Current JD relation source mismatch' using errcode='22023'; end if;
  -- Normalize only JSON integer representation and key order before storage.
  p_body:=private.jd_relation_canonical_json(p_body)::jsonb;
  revision_value:=coalesce(head.revision,0)+1;
  insert into public.job_requirement_versions(id,analysis_id,job_id,owner_id,organization_id,parent_version_id,revision,idempotency_key,command,content,created_at)
    values((p_body->>'id')::uuid,a.id,job.id,p_user_id,a.organization_id,head.id,revision_value,p_idempotency_key,command,p_body,(p_body->>'createdAt')::timestamptz);
  insert into public.job_requirements(version_id,id,owner_id,organization_id,item)
    select (p_body->>'id')::uuid,(value->>'id')::uuid,p_user_id,a.organization_id,value from jsonb_array_elements(p_body->'requirements');
  insert into public.audit_events(organization_id,actor_id,action,target_type,target_id,outcome,request_id)
    values(a.organization_id,p_user_id,'requirements.relations.import','job_requirement_version',(p_body->>'id')::uuid,'success',p_request_id);
  return jsonb_build_object('status','applied','versionId',p_body->>'id','revision',revision_value,'idempotent',false);
end; $$;

revoke all on function
  private.jd_relation_unicode_profile(),private.jd_relation_ln_ranges(),private.jd_relation_json_schema(),private.jd_relation_admission_profile(),
  private.jd_relation_canonical_json(jsonb,boolean,integer),private.jd_relation_in_ranges(jsonb,integer),private.jd_relation_mapping(jsonb,integer),
  private.jd_relation_lower(text),private.jd_relation_fold(text),private.jd_relation_trim(text),private.jd_relation_normalize(text,boolean),
  private.jd_relation_class_contents(jsonb),private.jd_relation_pattern(text),private.jd_relation_matches(text,text,integer,integer,boolean,boolean),
  private.jd_relation_test(text,text,boolean),private.jd_relation_literals(text,text,text),private.jd_relation_source_lines(text),
  private.jd_relation_heading(text),private.jd_relation_importance(text,text),private.jd_relation_alias(text),private.jd_relation_alias_mentions(text),
  private.jd_relation_requirement(text,jsonb,text,text,integer,integer,jsonb,jsonb,text,boolean,integer),private.jd_relation_expected_body(jsonb),
  private.jd_relation_duration(text,jsonb,boolean,boolean),private.jd_relation_relations(text,jsonb,jsonb,boolean),
  private.jd_relation_lengthless_schema(jsonb,integer),private.jd_relation_lengths_valid(jsonb,jsonb,integer),private.jd_relation_utf16_length(text),
  private.jd_relation_span(text,integer,integer),private.jd_relation_clean(jsonb,text,jsonb,text,integer),private.jd_relation_project(jsonb),
  private.job_requirement_relations_valid(jsonb),private.job_requirement_stored_shape_valid(jsonb),private.reject_legacy_job_requirement_downgrade()
  from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;
revoke all on function public.save_job_requirement_relations(uuid,uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text) from public,anon,authenticated,service_role;
grant execute on function public.save_job_requirement_relations(uuid,uuid,jsonb,uuid,uuid,text) to service_role;

commit;
